findings.title: Increment the retry counter atomically
findings.body: Both failure paths write `reminder.retryCount + 1` using the value read before processing the batch. If cron invocations overlap and both fail to schedule the same reminder with retryCount 0, both write 1, so two failed attempts are recorded as only one and the reminder is retried again instead of being deleted. Use Prisma's atomic increment operation in both paths to avoid losing failed attempts.

findings.title: Do not let failure bookkeeping abort the entire reminder batch
findings.body: The new database update inside the catch block can itself throw, but has no error handling. For example, if a reminder is deleted while the Twilio request is in flight, the update fails because the record no longer exists; a database error in the preceding update can likewise recur here. Previously these per-reminder errors were logged and processing continued. Now the handler exits before processing any remaining reminders, so one failed bookkeeping update prevents unrelated SMS reminders from being scheduled. Handle bookkeeping failures separately so the loop can continue.
